A '''Rebel underground''' existed in the [[Bormea sector/Legends|Bormea sector]]. After serving with local [[Corulag security force|security forces]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Corulag/Legends|Corulag]], [[Vildar Blin]] joined the [[Sector/Legends|sector's]] [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel Alliance]] underground.
